summary: Cowork-team daily document redesign v2.1 — 7 PO additions integrated. v2.1 adds: (6) language register boundary (daily-doc analysis prose in plain Vietnamese; caveman stays on RETURN/signals/DASHBOARD only; boundary table in Design Point I; encoded in daily-document-spec.md), (7) context-loading discipline as binding audit (cowork-refactory-expert audits all flows post-migration; bootstrap-only rule inherited from waterfall-lazy-load; F36 new audit pass; Phase-2+3 QA gates updated; executor split: CRE=flow rewrites, AF=structural/new-file edits). All v1+v2 decisions intact.
v1_overrides: Design Point C: alert-commander no longer calls send_telegram(channel=market) directly — replaced by 30s danger-drain lane in delivery cron
Postman section: renamed to delivery cron; two-lane (30s danger + 5min normal); SOLE market sender
new_additions: Addition 1: Delivery channel exclusivity — no cowork agent sends to market; agents keep direct send for work/bug
Addition 2: push_mode full|delta; market-push-state.json fingerprint; unchanged intraday tick = no push
Addition 3: Watch/Attention Register — docs/attention/watch.md; per-agent ## WATCH subsection; CHEF consolidates; 8-field item schema; lifecycle open→triggered→resolved|expired
Addition 4: Retention lifecycle — roll-up-before-prune; defaults daily=14d weekly=8w monthly=24m yearly=indefinite; digest-predict prune runner; fail-safe verify-before-delete
Addition 5: One-time migration recap F-MIG1–F-MIG4 gated before P3.7 legacy cleanup

Addition 6: Language register boundary — daily-doc analysis prose in comprehensible Vietnamese; caveman/ULTRA stays on RETURN blocks, signals, DASHBOARD pokes, structural machine fields; boundary table in Design Point I; Language rule encoded in daily-document-spec.md; reconciled with token-economy skill; extends feedback_market_report_plain_vietnamese upstream

Addition 7: Context-loading discipline binding audit — cowork-refactory-expert performs audit pass (F36) after F18 and before Phase-3 QA gate; bootstrap-only rule (own-section delta + header only for domain agents); inherited from waterfall-lazy-load + CLAUDE.md lazy-load pattern; Phase-2 and Phase-3 QA gates gain 2 new criteria each; executor split: CRE=flow rewrites, AF=structural edits

Phase 2 (F9-F17): Parallel run — header write + agents append to daily folder with ## WATCH subsections + Vietnamese prose, existing delivery unchanged

Phase 3 (F18-F29 + F-MIG1-F-MIG4 + F36): Full cutover — delta-read, delivery cron (2 lanes), outbox cutover, watch consolidation, CHEF reads daily folder, migration recap-then-clean, retention prune wired into digest-predict, cowork-refactory-expert audit pass
